translation: tu; imperativo per pulsanti e menu
note: Address the user with "tu", as Microsoft, Apple and Google Italian UIs do; never "Lei"/"voi". Buttons and menu items: 2nd person imperative, sentence case ("Apri", "Salva una copia…"). Prefer impersonal phrasing in messages ("Impossibile aprire {}").
No English Title Case: "Export Image…" → "Esporta immagine…". Product and format names keep their capitals.
Curly double quotes around names and inserted values; keep straight quotes only inside code, commands and configuration examples.
Could not open {} → "Impossibile aprire {}". Lowercase error fragments stay lowercase.

term: For research and education. Not a medical device; not for primary diagnosis.
translation: Per la ricerca e la didattica. Non è un dispositivo medico; non è destinato alla diagnosi primaria.

A group of overlay graphics; "livello" is reserved for pyramid levels.
